title: Put a fire out
kid_text: Drown it, stir it, and touch-test.
safety: Fully extinguish: drown, stir, drown again, and touch-test for heat before leaving.

steps.text: Stir the ash with a stick.
Listen. A hiss means it is still hot.
Touch the ash. It must feel cool.

mistakes.text: You leave while the ash still hisses.
mistakes.fix: Drown and stir one more time.
